import numpy as np
e=df['eps'].values; t=df['T'].values; s=df['sigma'].values
var=np.var(s)
def lm(f,p0,iters=300):
    p=np.array(p0,float); lam=1e-3
    def r(p): return s-f(p)
    R=r(p); c=R@R
    for _ in range(iters):
        J=np.column_stack([(f(p+1e-7*np.eye(len(p))[k]*(1+abs(p[k])))-f(p))/(1e-7*(1+abs(p[k]))) for k in range(len(p))])
        A=J.T@J; g=J.T@R
        try: d=np.linalg.solve(A+lam*np.diag(np.diag(A)+1e-12),g)
        except: break
        pn=p+d; Rn=r(pn)
        cn=Rn@Rn if np.all(np.isfinite(Rn)) else np.inf
        if cn<c: p,R,c=pn,Rn,cn; lam*=0.3
        else: lam*=5
        if lam>1e12: break
    return p, c/len(s)/var

def full_rel(bases, c2s=np.linspace(0.70,0.80,201)):
    best=(np.inf,None)
    for c2 in c2s:
        E=e*np.exp(-c2*e)/t
        X=np.column_stack([E]+bases)
        c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,s,rcond=None)
        r=np.sum((s-X@c)**2)/np.sum((s-s.mean())**2)
        if r<best[0]: best=(r,c2,c)
    return best

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    c = params[0]
    return c*np.exp(-c*np.sqrt(T)) + params[1]*eps*np.exp(-params[2]*eps)/T + params[3]*np.exp(-params[4]*T - params[5]*np.sqrt(T))*T**params[6]
